name: route-summary-cwm-sol
description: Capture and compare the route summary information and show the differences between pre and post upgrade if any. If stash is passed as part of the input then the execution data is matched with the stash. Otherwise, the stash data is returned. "Failure" status is returned if there is some execution error. "Warning" status is returned if the stash data does not match with the execution data.

definition.name: route-summary-cwm-sol

dataConditions.name: check-iosxr
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco 8000 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540L Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5700 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 9000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco XRv 9000 Series Virtual Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5500 Series") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540 Series Routers") }

dataConditions.name: check-iosxe
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 920 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 900 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 1000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8000V Edge Chassis Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 3650 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8300 Series Edge Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 series switches") }

commands.template:
Value RouteSource (.+?)
Value Routes (\d+)
Value Backup (\d+)
Value Deleted (\d+)
Value Memory (\d+)

Start
  ^${RouteSource}\s{2,}${Routes}\s+${Backup}\s+${Deleted}\s+${Memory} -> Record

Value Filldown VRF (.*)
Value RouteSource (.+?)
Value Routes (\d+)
Value Backup (\d+)
Value Deleted (\d+)
Value Memory (\d+)

Start
  ^VRF: ${VRF}
  ^${RouteSource}\s{2,}${Routes}\s+${Backup}\s+${Deleted}\s+${Memory} -> Record

logs.message: Forming inputs for route summary check

data.template:
Value RouteSource (.+?)
Value Networks (\d+)
Value Subnets (\d+)
Value Replicates (\d+)
Value Overhead (\d+)
Value Memory (\d+)

Start
  ^${RouteSource}\s+${Networks}\s+${Subnets}\s+${Replicates}\s+${Overhead}\s+${Memory} -> Record

logs.message: Forming inputs for route summary check

actionDataFilter.results: ${{message: .message, routeSummaryData: (if (.stash != null and .stash.output != []) then [.stash.output[] | map(select(.RouteSource != "Total" and .RouteSource != ""))] else null end), status: .status}}

logs.message: Calling rakutil executor for multiple commands
Calling rakutil executor for multiple commands

dataConditions.name: output is valid
dataConditions.condition: ${ if .rakutilExecutorData.status=="success" then true else false end}

dataConditions.name: output is invalid
dataConditions.condition: ${ if .rakutilExecutorData.status=="failed" then true else false end}

dataConditions.name: output is valid
dataConditions.condition: ${ if .rakutilExecutorData.status=="success" then true else false end}

dataConditions.name: output is invalid
dataConditions.condition: ${ if .rakutilExecutorData.status=="failed" then true else false end}

dataConditions.name: Check if there is a difference in route summary

logs.message: Getting differences in route summary data between current execution and stash

stateDataFilter.output: ${ .warnings += [.stash.RouteSummary as $f1 | .rakutilExecutorData.stash.output as $f2 | ($f1 - $f2).[] as $f3 | reduce $f3 as {$Memory,$Networks,$Overhead,$Replicates,$RouteSource,$Subnets} (null; ($f2.[] | select(.RouteSource == $RouteSource) | ("For "  + $RouteSource + " route, " + ("Memory" + (if((.Memory|tonumber)>($Memory|tonumber)) then (" increased from " + $Memory + " to " + .Memory) else (if((.Memory|tonumber)==($Memory|tonumber)) then " remained same" else (" decreased from " + $Memory + " to " + .Memory)end) end)) + (", Networks" + (if((.Networks|tonumber)>($Networks|tonumber)) then (" increased from " + $Networks + " to " + .Networks) else (if((.Networks|tonumber)==($Networks|tonumber)) then " remained same" else (" decreased from " + $Networks + " to " + .Networks)end) end)) + (", Overhead" + (if((.Overhead|tonumber)>($Overhead|tonumber)) then (" increased from " + $Overhead + " to " + .Overhead) else (if((.Overhead|tonumber)==($Overhead|tonumber)) then " remained same" else (" decreased from " + $Overhead + " to " + .Overhead)end) end)) + (", Replicates" + (if((.Replicates|tonumber)>($Replicates|tonumber)) then (" increased from " + $Replicates + " to " + .Replicates) else (if((.Replicates|tonumber)==($Replicates|tonumber)) then " remained same" else (" decreased from " + $Replicates + " to " + .Replicates)end) end)) + (", Overhead" + (if((.Overhead|tonumber)>($Overhead|tonumber)) then (" increased from " + $Overhead + " to " + .Overhead) else (if((.Overhead|tonumber)==($Overhead|tonumber)) then " remained same" else (" decreased from " + $Overhead + " to " + .Overhead)end) end)) + (", Subnets" + (if((.Subnets|tonumber)>($Subnets|tonumber)) then (" increased from " + $Subnets + " to " + .Subnets) else (if((.Subnets|tonumber)==($Subnets|tonumber)) then " remained same" else (" decreased from " + $Subnets + " to " + .Subnets)end) end)))))] }

logs.message: Getting missing routes between current execution and stash

stateDataFilter.output: ${ (([.stash.RouteSummary[] | .RouteSource]) - ([.rakutilExecutorData.stash.output[] | .RouteSource])) as $f1 | .warnings += (if $f1|length != 0 then [ ("Found missing routes - " + ($f1 | join(", "))) ] else [] end) }

logs.message: Getting extra routes in current execution

stateDataFilter.output: ${ (([.rakutilExecutorData.stash.output[] | .RouteSource]) - ([.stash.RouteSummary[] | .RouteSource]) ) as $f1 | .warnings += (if $f1|length != 0 then [("Found extra routes - " + ($f1 | join(", "))) ] else [] end) | .status="warning" | .message="Differences are found in route summary data in post-upgrade check." }

logs.message: Getting GRT routeSource differences

stateDataFilter.output: ${((.warnings) += [(.stash.GRT as $f1 | .rakutilExecutorData.routeSummaryData[0] as $f2 | ([$f1[].RouteSource] - [$f2[].RouteSource]) + ([$f2[].RouteSource] - [$f1[].RouteSource]) | join(", ") | if . == "" then null else (. + ": this/these RouteSources is/are different between pre and post upgrade checks (GRT).") end)])}

logs.message: Getting GRT route differences

stateDataFilter.output: ${ ((.warnings) += [.rakutilExecutorData.routeSummaryData[0][] as $f1 | .stash.GRT[] as $f2 | reduce $f1 as {$RouteSource,$Routes} (null; $f2 | select(.RouteSource == $RouteSource) | ((select(.Routes != $Routes))| ("Differences in number of GRT routes detected: " + "RouteSource " + .RouteSource + ":" + .Routes + " -> " + $Routes)))]) }

logs.message: Getting VRF routeSource differences

stateDataFilter.output: ${ ((.warnings) += [(.stash.VRF as $f1 | .rakutilExecutorData.routeSummaryData[1] as $f2 | ([$f1[].RouteSource] - [$f2[].RouteSource]) + ([$f2[].RouteSource] - [$f1[].RouteSource]) | join(", ") | if . == "" then null else (. + ": this/these RouteSources is/are different between pre and post upgrade checks (VRF).") end)]) }

logs.message: Getting VRF route differences

stateDataFilter.output: ${ ((.warnings) += [.rakutilExecutorData.routeSummaryData[1][] as $f1 | .stash.VRF[] as $f2 | reduce $f1 as {$RouteSource,$VRF,$Routes} (null; $f2 | (select(.VRF == $VRF and .RouteSource == $RouteSource))| ((select(.Routes != $Routes) | ("VRF:" + .VRF + " RouteSource:" + .RouteSource + "->" + "Pre:" + .Routes + " Post:" + $Routes ))))]) }

logs.message: Route summary check completed with warning/s

stateDataFilter.output: ${{"status": "warning", "message": ("Route summary is captured and it has warnings. " + (if .warnings != [] then (.warnings | join(", ")) else "" end)), "stash": .stash}}

logs.message: Reoute summary check completed with warnings
Route summary check completed successfully. No difference found between stash and current execution.

stateDataFilter.output: ${{"status": "success", "message": "Route summary is captured successfully. No difference found between stash and current execution.", "stash": .stash}}

logs.message: Route summary check completed successfully. No difference found between stash and current execution.

stateDataFilter.output: ${{"status": "success", "message": "Route summary is captured successfully. No difference found between stash and current execution.", "stash": {RouteSummary: .rakutilExecutorData.stash.output}}}

logs.message: Route summary check completed successfully. Creating stash.
Route summary check completed successfully. Creating stash.

stateDataFilter.output: ${.stash = if (.stash[0][0].VRF == null) then {GRT: .stash[0], VRF: .stash[1]} else {GRT: .stash[1], VRF: .stash[0]} end}

logs.message: Error while executing route summary check mop activity

stateDataFilter.output: ${{"status": "failed", "message": (if .rakutilExecutorData.message then .rakutilExecutorData.message else "Error while executing route summary check mop activity." end)}}

logs.message: Selected product series is not supported

stateDataFilter.output: ${{status:"failed", message: "Selected product series is not supported." }}

logs.message: Route summary exited abnormally

definition.description: Capture and compare the route summary information and show the differences between pre and post upgrade if any. If stash is passed as part of the input then the execution data is matched with the stash. Otherwise, the stash data is returned. "Failure" status is returned if there is some execution error. "Warning" status is returned if the stash data does not match with the execution data.
